title: KAN-Robust-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.21488v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While machine learning models have demonstrated strong performance in many domains, these models have shown profound vulnerabilities when they are exposed to adversarial threats. While adversarial attacks fall into various categories, the most prominent category in research studies is evasion. In evasion attacks, the adversary generates perturbed versions of samples, which might not be observable by human eyes. These samples generally fool the machine learning models with high confidence. This phenomenon poses a significant security violation against machine learning models. In this paper, we investigate the certified and empirical robustness of various Kolmogorov-Arnold network architectures against strong evasion attacks. At first, we provide the mathematical foundations for randomized smoothing and interval bound propagation, and report the $\ell_2$-certified robustness of the models under randomized smoothing. translated_title: KAN-Robust-Bench：评估Kolmogorov-Arnold网络鲁棒性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 尽管机器学习模型在许多领域表现出强大的性能，但这些模型在面对对抗性威胁时显示出深刻的脆弱性。虽然对抗性攻击分为多种类别，但研究中最突出的类别是规避攻击。在规避攻击中，对手生成样本的扰动版本，这些扰动可能人眼无法察觉。这些样本通常以高置信度欺骗机器学习模型。这种现象对机器学习模型构成了重大的安全威胁。在本文中，我们研究了各种Kolmogorov-Arnold网络架构在强规避攻击下的认证和实证鲁棒性。首先，我们提供了随机平滑和区间边界传播的数学基础，并报告了模型在随机平滑下的$\ell_2$认证鲁棒性。之后，我们系统性地进行了相关评估。
tldr: 本文提出了KAN-Robust-Bench基准，首次系统评估了Kolmogorov-Arnold网络在强规避攻击下的认证与实证鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces KAN-Robust-Bench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating the certified and empirical robustness of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks against strong evasion attacks.
